entry.title: New: Resolution 445 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 445-26 & GOEAC-92 - 02/04/26
entry.content:
REQUESTS THE COUNTY AUDITOR TO CONDUCT A PERFORMANCE AUDIT OF THE USE AND EFFECTIVENESS OF REAL PROPERTY TAX REVENUES APPROPRIATED FOR HOUSING AND HOMELESSNESS

The scope of the audit includes evaluation of performance with respect to the Office of Housing and Community Development’s Strategic Roadmap, data indicators and metrics, and compliance with the County Code.
